title: 0LB1LF: no halt in 8·10^19 steps
text: The chain-phase engine for 1RB1RA_1LC0RD_1LD1LB_1LE0LF_0RA---_0LB1LF now takes one macro step per repeating cycle of up to 4 increments and checkpoints its tape. It finds no halt in 8.07·10<sup>19</sup> steps (up from 3.5·10<sup>18</sup>). There a halving chain forms on the left side, which the engine does not read yet.
